verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report calls LanceDB 'one of the few options for embeddable vector databases' and describes using it inside an Electron application, which confirms in-process embedded use. First-party docs say the storage layer runs on local NVMe, and they reserve the remote `db://` connection for Enterprise, which implies local use is the default. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the embedded/in-process mode (e.g. connecting to a local path), and evidence on suitability for small workloads and lightweight local setup.
